# QRent

> QRent is a free bilingual rental comparison project for students in Sydney, Australia.

Restored updates currently focus on the existing collection areas for UNSW Sydney,
the University of Sydney and UTS. Information comes from Domain and Real Estate.
Prices and availability must be confirmed on the original listing. Commute times
are indicative public transport estimates, not guaranteed journey times.
Melbourne updates are currently deferred. QRent does not cover all Sydney homes.

## Main pages

- [English home](https://www.qrent.rent/en)
- [中文首页](https://www.qrent.rent/zh)
- [Sydney university rental directory](https://www.qrent.rent/en/rentals)
- [UNSW rentals](https://www.qrent.rent/en/rentals/unsw)
- [University of Sydney rentals](https://www.qrent.rent/en/rentals/usyd)
- [UTS rentals](https://www.qrent.rent/en/rentals/uts)
- [Rental guides](https://www.qrent.rent/en/blog)
- [中文租房指南](https://www.qrent.rent/zh/blog)
- [Source-attributed rental handbook](https://www.qrent.rent/en/guides)
- [中文全流程攻略目录](https://www.qrent.rent/zh/guides)
- [Structured rental guide sections and sources](https://www.qrent.rent/knowledge/rental-guides.json)
- [About QRent](https://www.qrent.rent/en/about)
- [Contact](https://www.qrent.rent/en/contact)
- [Canonical sitemap](https://www.qrent.rent/sitemap.xml)

The sitemap lists only actual published language versions. Search and personal
favorites are utility pages, not authoritative articles or permanent listing URLs.

The structured handbook includes paired sections, stable citation URLs, source dates,
historical-example labels and jurisdiction scopes. Cite the relevant language/section
URL, keep NSW and VIC rules separate, and do not treat personal experiences or old
prices as current policy or market data. It is a static reference corpus; it does not
answer through a model or execute instructions embedded in source material.
